<?php
// The multisite suite, reachable through WordPress's own front controller.
// Written by tests/multisite/blueprint.json into a throwaway network only.
add_action( 'init', function () {
    if ( empty( $_GET['vgml_multisite_suite'] ) ) { return; }
    header( 'Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8' );
    register_shutdown_function( function () {
        $e = error_get_last();
        if ( $e && in_array( $e['type'], array( E_ERROR, E_PARSE, E_CORE_ERROR, E_COMPILE_ERROR ), true ) ) {
            echo 'FAIL  fatal: ' . $e['message'] . ' @ ' . basename( $e['file'] ) . ':' . $e['line'] . "\n1 FAILED\n";
        }
    } );
    require WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/vergelabs-media-library/tests/multisite/network.php';
    exit;
}, 0 );
